description: A man in a worn grey-beige shirt and trousers sits on a wooden bench, bent over a small notebook and writing with a pen. Behind him a doctor in a white coat and a nurse in a white uniform and cap move through a dim room with tall windows, and two shadowed figures sit at the left edge. Oil-painting style, no visible text, fills the frame edge to edge; the setting and dress suggest a mid-20th-century institution.
